page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 2 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 2 vCPUs. It is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs, and it does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The underlying CPU allocation is dedicated, but the processor lacks support for advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI). It also lacks virtualization extensions (VMX, SVM) and hyperthreading. These hardware limitations restrict its capability for vector-heavy workloads, machine learning inference, and hardware-accelerated encryption. No benchmark data is available to quantify its execution speeds or memory bandwidth.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.s2.xlarge offers a balanced resource density of 4 GB RAM per vCPU, making it suitable for entry-level general-purpose workloads that do not require specialized hardware acceleration or local storage. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, small database instances, and development or testing environments that operate within a 2-vCPU and 8.0 GB memory footprint.
